_provenance.note: Oregon citation authorities. OAR (Oregon Administrative Rules) are cited as 'OAR 461-DDD-DDDD' (chapter-division-section, e.g. 'OAR 461-160-0420'). Oregon Revised Statutes are cited 'ORS DDD.DDD'.

oaroregon.note: periodic redeterminations — 12-month cert w/ 6-month interim report; 24-month elderly/disabled-no-earned-income w/ 12-month report
categorical eligibility (CE/ECE/BBCE) — 200% flat BBCE screen via Information and Referral Services pamphlet
ABAWD time limit — fixed 1/1/25-12/31/27 clock, 5 tribal exempt areas, 7-county discretionary exemption eff. 2/1/26
expedited services — federal-standard criteria ($150/$100, rent+utility test), 7-day issuance
court-ordered child support income exclusion — EXPIRED, not made permanent within 180 temp days
resource limits — SNAP $3,000 standard / $4,500 elderly-or-disabled, waived for cat-el households
shelter cost / utility allowance — FUA $515, LUA $404, IUA $65, TUA $81; currently a TEMPORARY rule effective 3/19/26-9/14/26
income deductions — standard ($209/$223/$261/$299), medical (actual-minus-$35 w/ $170 floor), shelter cap $744, homeless deduction $198.99
income and payment standards — 130%/100% FPL gross/net tests, SNAP payment standard (TFP) table

orstat.note: drug-felony treatment — general opt-out with a narrow trafficking-plus-supervision-plus-trading discretionary suspension path
